83	
84	## 4. Directness — the conditioning layer
85	
86	Directness conditions the weight a source carries for a given claim, as a categorical layer over the single ladder — never a separate hierarchy per scale, never a numeric confidence score (`evidence-methodology.md` §1.7; `schemas/directness.py`). Three dimensions: population-directness (EXACT/PARTIAL/PROXY/MISMATCH), value-directness (EXACT/WITHIN-TOLERANCE/NOT-FOUND/CONTRADICTED), scale-directness (DIRECT/ADJACENT/DOWN-WEIGHTED/NON-ANCHORING). They consolidate to one conditioning grade: DIRECT / DOWN-WEIGHTED / DISCOUNTED / NON-ANCHORING. The principle is **grain-matching, not specificity-ranking** — bidirectional per GRADE's directness (indirectness) domain: an aggregate systematic review is strongest for a population claim and down-weighted for a person-specific claim; a direct intervention study is the reverse.
87	
88	Four refinements close gaps found by adversarial review (2026-07-12); each is a separately ratifiable DR item:
89	
90	**G1 — Re-graining rule for T4/T5** `[NEW — DR-gated]`. `tier-system.md` §1 already says T4/T5 sources can support best-practice claims "if the standard itself rests on T1/T2 evidence." This document operationalizes that clause: a T4/T5 source is assigned `GRAIN_AGGREGATE` (and thereby escapes NON-ANCHORING at Population Mode) **only** when its evidence basis is documented as traceable to T1/T2 evidence, with that provenance recorded on the source record. Otherwise it keeps `GRAIN_CODE`. Untraceable standards convergence stays in the regulatory stratum where §2 put it.
91	
92	**G2 — NOT_ASSESSED is not EXACT** `[NEW — DR-gated]`. `consolidate()` currently treats a `None` population-directness as "not applicable — does not block," which is correct for claims where the dimension genuinely does not apply, but only 27 of 640 sources carry any `evidence_population_match` row — so at backfill scale, "never assessed" would silently grade as fully direct. The engine distinguishes **NOT_ASSESSED** (dimension applies, no assessment exists) from **not-applicable** (dimension genuinely inapplicable). A NOT_ASSESSED dimension caps consolidation at DOWN-WEIGHTED and flags the source for assessment. Absence of assessment is never treated as evidence of directness — the Altman & Bland distinction (`evidence-methodology.md` §2.4) applied to the project's own metadata.
93	
94	**G3 — Co-1 grain follows `co1_source_type`** `[NEW — DR-gated]`. Co-1 is not uniform in grain: `dpo_position_statement` is population-grain community knowledge (→ GRAIN_AGGREGATE); `lived_experience_publication`, `participatory_research` and individual-testimony corpora are individual-grain (→ GRAIN_SPECIFIC), which is also what `grain_for` gives any value it does not name. The column declares no CHECK; `schemas.enums.Co1SourceType` is its vocabulary (RULINGS R11). This makes the matrix row-pair in §3 mechanical, and it encodes the ethical rule already in `co1-operational.md`: a DPO position paper is community consensus — it anchors Population-Mode claims *and does not override an individual at Person Mode*; an individual narrative is the reverse.
95	
96	**G6 — Grain derives from (evidence_type × tier), not evidence_type alone** `[NEW — DR-gated]`. `standard_eb` spans two strata: T2 named-organisation evidence-based standards (synthesis-tier — the "same epistemic move as sr_meta, different machinery," `tier-system.md` §2) and T4 international standards (regulatory stratum). The current type-only default grains both as CODE, which would make T2 DPO/professional-body standards NON-ANCHORING at Population Mode — contradicting `evidence-methodology.md` §1.6, which lists Tier 2 among the anchoring strata. Resolution: `standard_eb` at T2 → GRAIN_AGGREGATE; `standard_eb` at T4/T5 → GRAIN_CODE (unless re-grained per G1). Grain assignment is a function of the (type, tier) pair.
97	
98	### 4.5 Genealogy — counting roots, not documents
99	
100	Directness conditions how much a source's *claim* weighs. Genealogy conditions how much a value's *apparent agreement* weighs. It gives the project's central adjudication — best practice versus consensus — a computable form. `[H1 — DR-2026-07-13-value-genealogy-and-derivation-handshake, ratified 2026-07-13]`
101	
102	The doctrine in one line: **precedent counts documents; evidence counts roots.** Twenty-four jurisdictions specifying the same figure is one fact about transmission, not twenty-four facts about disabled people. This is the §2 convergence-not-evidence rule pushed one level down — from *which stratum is agreeing?* to *how many independent measurements are they all agreeing about?* The corridor case is the worked proof (§8.1; `references/methodology/value-genealogy-worked-example-corridor-width.md`): 1500mm turning "circles" across 24 jurisdictions trace to a single 1970s anthropometric root whose own authors record it as needing updating; the 1800mm passing consensus has no traceable root anywhere in the corpus; 2440/2400mm has two independent roots (ASL proxemics, Co-1; swept-path anthropometry, T3) plus one untraced regulatory convergence.
103	
104	**Storage.** Each extracted value on `source_value_extractions` carries `root_id`, `root_type` (`measurement_primary` / `participatory_finding` / `committee_assertion` / `derived_calculation` / `untraced`), `root_ref_id`, `echo_of`, `measurement_paradigm`, `device_class`, `root_population_note`, `file_anchor`, `root_classification_basis`, `contested`. The discriminator is the view `v_value_independence`: independent roots **per parameter**, counting DISTINCT roots and excluding `committee_assertion`. *(Swept 2026-09-10 with migration 073, which names this file as a prose caller of that view. The sentence read "per (parameter, population)"; the population half went with migration 071, which took `population_code` out of the view's grain, and 073 re-derived the view a second time onto `parameter_id`. It groups by `parameter_id` alone — the lens is the determination's, not the root count's.)*
105	
106	**Three anti-gaming disciplines, structural rather than editorial.** (a) *Root registry* — a `root_id` must resolve either to a `root_ref_id` in `evidence_sources` or to a registered external-root stub, so two extractors cannot mint two ids for one root and double the count. (b) *Untraced rows carry NULL `root_id` and are excluded from the count* — untraceability can never out-score a traced chain. (c) *`root_classification_basis` + `contested`* — the root-versus-echo judgment is recordably disputable, not free-text folklore.
107	
108	**AMENDED** 2026-10-14 in the first alternative of discipline (a), by `references/project-standards.md`: "the rule becomes that `source_value_extractions.root_id` references `external_root_registry` and nothing else". A `root_id` names a registered external root; a root held in `evidence_sources` is named by `root_ref_id`. The rest of this paragraph stands. See the ledger entry "Recording 2026-10-14, third part".
109	
110	**The six adjudication tests — four encoded, two doctrinal.** Root, Independence, Paradigm-commensurability and Fit-population map onto the fields above. *Currency* rides the existing supersession machinery (`evidence_sources.superseded_by_ref_id` + DR-2026-05-24) rather than duplicating it. *Interest* — who convened the consensus? — is recorded in `root_classification_basis` notes: doctrinal, not a column, until a real vocabulary for convening-interest emerges from use. Cross-paradigm and cross-device-class applications are recorded as **derivations, never identities**: a static turning circle cannot corroborate a swept-path envelope (most real turns are asymmetric spin turns; scooters have no pivot at all), and a figure a source declares manual-wheelchair-only does not silently become a power-chair figure.
111	
112	`[BUILD STATE 2026-08-15 — DATED, AND THE FIGURE HAS MOVED: the fields, the external-root registry and v_value_independence exist in the canonical DB; source_value_extractions held 0 rows ON THAT DATE and holds neither 0 nor any number this sentence may state (rule 7a). Count it, never quote it: `python3 -c "import sqlite3;print(sqlite3.connect('file:data/guidebook.db?mode=ro',uri=True).execute('select count(*) from source_value_extractions').fetchone()[0])"`. The clause below is conditioned on that count being zero and stops applying the moment it is not. Genealogy is an available discriminator with nothing yet to discriminate — the extraction pass is Phase-E work. No determination may cite root-independence until rows exist, and an empty view returning no roots is not a finding of no independence: it is the Altman & Bland distinction (§9) applied to this table.]`
113	
114	## 5. Determinations — states, and what each state is *about*
115	
116	Each (`parameter_id` × at least one of `identity_code`, `icf_code`, `needs_code`) cell holds one of four states (`evidence-methodology.md` §2; storage: migration 026): `stated`, `provisional`, `pending`, `not_applicable`. The determination is written by a pure function — same evidence + same `rule_version` ⇒ same state and same `derivation_sha` (`workplan/best-practices-assessment-system.md` §3) — and no `stated` or `provisional` determination can exist without non-empty `governing_refs` (anti-hallucination, DR-2026-07-12 item 10; `pending`/`not_applicable` rows carry a gap link or rationale instead).
117	
118	**Scale-tagging** `[NEW — DR-gated: G1b]`. Every determination is tagged with the design scale its claim speaks to, and the tag governs what the determination may be *called* in every rendering:
119	
120	- A determination anchored in T1/Co-1/T2/Co-2 (with T3 per its threshold DR) is a **Population-Mode best-practice determination** — the only kind rendered at anchoring strength (`●` band, subject to its conditioning). Since the weighted-strength amendment (owner directive 2026-07-21, Option A; `tier-system.md` §8) the phrase "best practice" is no longer exclusive to it: the weak band below extends the phrase, never the strength (the ◐ band applies at citation level only — footnote ††).
121	- A determination whose entire basis is the regulatory stratum (T4–6) is a **Universal-Mode regulatory determination**, flagged `regulatory_stratum_only` (extending migration 026's `code_floor_only`, which covers only the T6-only case, to the full T4–6-only case). It answers "what does the harmonised/statutory floor specify?" — and, per owner directive 2026-07-21 (Option A), it **is a best-practice determination at the weak band (○)**: best available *as currently known, given that nothing stronger says otherwise*. It renders in every register, for every audience, **only** flagged weak/code-derived with the convergence-not-evidence caveat — never unflagged, never at anchoring strength (amended I3, §6); its state remains `provisional`, never `stated`. `v_best_practice` includes it as a queryably distinct weak-band row, carrying the row's `marker` (migration 116, which replaced the `strength_band` column of migration 029). This sentence previously read "today the view still excludes `regulatory_stratum_only` rows … and no strength-band column exists", which migration 029 had already made false. The `provisional` confidence flag still names the absent anchoring dimensions (`evidence-methodology.md` §2.3's flag, with teeth at T4/T5, not just T6).
122	- **Most-accommodating floor selection (direction-aware)** `[Option A, owner directive 2026-07-21]`. Where jurisdictions' code floors differ on a parameter, the regulatory-stratum determination anchors on the **most accommodating available value, read per the parameter's accessibility direction** — best-for-the-user, not largest-number: the widest minimum corridor, but the *lowest* maximum threshold height and the *gentlest* maximum ramp slope. The parameter's direction is to be recorded with the determination, and the passed-over floors remain visible as the jurisdiction spread (they are code-baseline facts, not discarded evidence). **Where the accessibility direction is population-contested** — e.g. flush thresholds aid wheeled mobility but remove the tactile cues cane users rely on; heavy acoustic absorption aids hearing-aid users but degrades echolocation; brighter light aids low vision but harms photosensitive users — **most-accommodating selection is inapplicable: no single value is anchored; the conflict is recorded via the conflicts machinery, and the jurisdiction spread is rendered with each population's direction stated** (suppressing the divergence would itself be an error, `mission-and-epistemics.md`). `[LANDED 2026-09-13 — migrations 078/079 and `assess_cell.compose_value()`. All three items that marker named now exist: per-parameter accessibility-direction metadata (`base_parameters.accessibility_direction`, with its rationale required by the schema and written by `db.py set-parameter-direction`), direction-aware selection (the widest minimum under `higher_is_better`, the lowest under `lower_is_better`), and a `contested` state that declines to anchor any value. Where the engine cannot compose a value it records WHY in `specifications.value_note`, so a contested direction is distinguishable from an unrecorded one — the four decline-reasons were all a bare NULL before 079. Verified by driving the engine over the same two divergent governing claims under each direction: `higher_is_better` selected 10, `lower_is_better` selected 4. DR-2026-07-21 §5: markers are removed only by the follow-up that lands the behavior.]`
123	- Person Mode produces no stored determinations at all: the assessed answer addresses the individual's own specific functional needs — their circumstances, capabilities, impairments, and comorbidities — and may be *informed by* a related disability population without being *bounded by* it (§3); a resolved value may fall outside any population range, and comorbid or hard-to-classify presentations routinely require exactly that. What the guidebook stores for Person Mode is the *handoff* — the functional parameter driving assessment and the population-range scaffold the assessment starts from (`armature_v4.md` §4.6 "Mode S handoff" — vocabulary normalized to "Person-Mode handoff" per §7).  [RETIRED-VOCAB-OK]
124	
125	This closes the channel through which the convergence-not-evidence trap could re-enter: previously, `evidence-methodology.md` §2.3 let T4–6 convergence produce a `provisional` synthesis that §3.4's voice line could render as "[N] jurisdictions' standards converge on [value]" without a mandatory scale disclaimer, and the policymaker profile up-weights exactly that stratum. Since Option A (2026-07-21) the closure works by **mandatory flagging, not suppression**: scale-tagging plus the weak/code-derived flag make the laundering path mechanically impossible rather than editorially discouraged — the regulatory value may now be *rendered* as weak-band best practice, but it can never be rendered *unflagged*, never above the register map's `(provisional, regulatory_stratum_only)` row, and never with the convergence-not-evidence caveat dropped — and by amended I3 (§6) that flag-and-caveat requirement binds **every** rendering of the value, not only best-practice-phrased ones.
126	
127	Two further determinations-layer refinements surfaced by the operational pilot, each separately ratifiable:
128	
129	**G7 — the `stated`-threshold wording admits what §1.6 anchors** `[NEW — DR-gated]`. §2.2's OR-clause names "Tier 1–3 **clinical** evidence… Co-1… Co-2" while §1.6 lists **Tier 2** (both streams — sr_meta *and* named-organisation evidence-based standards) among the anchoring strata. A cell anchored solely by a T2 evidence-based standard (e.g. a professional-advisory flash-rate recommendation) is `stated` under §1.6's reading and unreachable under §2.2's literal wording. Resolution: amend §2.2 to admit T2 anchors explicitly (both streams), keeping the G6 grain rule so T2-standard anchoring never leaks to T4/T5.
130	
131	**G8 — `pending_assessment` cells may render, with mandatory disclosure** `[NEW — DR-gated]`. §3.4 says `pending_assessment` cells are "not rendered — flagged for assessment before publication," treating the status as transitional. With `source_value_extractions` empty, multi-axis cells are honestly `pending_assessment` for as long as value extraction lags — suppressing them would hide the corpus's strongest cells because of a metadata backlog. Resolution: a `pending_assessment` cell may render **only** with the value-level-convergence-pending disclosure in every register (the register map's `stated_multi_axis` rows carry it), and §3.4 is amended accordingly.
132	
133	### 5.5 The derivation handshake — and the cultural-claim protection
134	
135	The corpus derives values along two paths that have never been required to meet: **top-down** from population and community (BPCs, Co-1, every population join) and **bottom-up** from function (the ICF-indexed `references/fdr/` corpus, deliberately population-blind at collection; the functional-deficit-auditor's population↔ICF mapping, which lived as unvalidated skill prose until migration 080 promoted it into the table now named `identity_icf_map` on 2026-09-13). No mechanism requires the paths to agree before a value ships, and dual derivation is undetectable by query. `[H2–H4 — DR-2026-07-13-value-genealogy-and-derivation-handshake, ratified 2026-07-13]`
136	
137	**The rule.** Every determination records `functional_basis` (mechanism type per the FDA taxonomy, ICF code(s), and supporting refs including FDR file anchors) and `derivation_paths` ∈ `dual` / `population_only` / `function_only`. Dual-path convergence is recorded as itself evidence — doctrine #3, convergence across independent axes, extended from evidence axes to derivation paths. A single-path assertion is permitted **only with a named-path rationale**, in the exact shape of the existing `single_axis` rule.
138	
139	**The cultural/dignity-claim protection — a named commitment, ratified 2026-07-13.** Claims whose normative force is community-rooted remain **fully assertable as `population_only`**. The handshake makes a derivation *explicit*; it never requires a mechanism where the claim is cultural, and **no functional derivation may flatten, reduce, or override a community claim** — there is no bottom-up override of Co-1. A signing-space corridor width is not a wheelchair-envelope calculation that came out wrong; it is a different claim, held by the community whose language it serves, and it stands on that basis. This was ratified as a named commitment rather than inherited silently, because it is the dignity line the architecture exists to hold: it binds every register, every audience, and the engine. It is the determinations-layer expression of the asymmetry principle (§3, G4) and of G3's refusal to let population-grain speech stand in for individuals.
140	
141	**Boundary criterion — the protection is anchored, not self-declared.** "Community-rooted" means anchored by Co-1/participatory provenance per `co1_source_type` (`dpo_position_statement`, participatory peer-reviewed work) or by an equivalent documented community process. A `population_only` claim *without* such an anchor is simply a single-path claim owing the standard named-path rationale; it gains no cultural exemption by assertion. The criterion exists so the protection cannot become a route around the mechanism requirement — it protects the claims it was written for, and only those.
142	
143	**H3 — the population↔function mapping is data, not skill prose.** One table (`identity_icf_map`): population code × ICF d-code × mechanism × confidence × provenance, promoting the FDA mapping and the armature's mapping-confidence classifications out of prose into provenance-bearing rows. A **named reconciliation sub-step runs before load**: the FDA vocabulary and the live `base_taxonomy_identity` table disagree, so the migration ships an FDA-code→population-code crosswalk in which every mapping is a recorded row and every unmapped code is logged as a finding — no silent aliasing, no FK failures discovered at load time. The table is simultaneously the forward map (population → characteristic function) and the substrate for reverse-mapping, which is what would have flagged DEAF's absence from the corridor item's population links mechanically rather than by eye.
144	
145	**H4 — the existing advisory checks become gates, with deadlock discipline.** FDA verdicts UNLINKED / MISLINKED / UNDER-CONSERVATIVE and FDR delta-classification CONTRADICTS force the affected cell to `provisional` — never `stated` — until resolved. The gate binds **only where a check has actually run**: no silent pretence of coverage. Gate rows carry the tier and type of the triggering source (a QUESTION, the one verdict with no source, carries neither and never caps a cell: OD-21), so a grey-tier CONTRADICTS cannot pin a T1-anchored cell indefinitely and thereby invert the ladder; resolution is a named path — evidence-auditor adjudication recorded on the cell together with its rationale — so no cell sits at `provisional` with no owner of resolution.
146	
147	`[LANDED 2026-09-13 — migration 080 and the engine wiring in the same change. What the marker named is built: `specifications` carries `functional_basis`, `derivation_paths`, `derivation_rationale` and `cultural_claim_anchor`; `population_icf_links` (now `identity_icf_map`) exists and holds the promoted FDA mapping with its crosswalk reasoning per row; `assess_cell.derivation_handshake()` implements H4 with the ladder-inversion guard, and a binding gate caps a cell at `provisional` and never moves it in any other direction. [RETIRED-VOCAB-OK]
148	
149	**THE DIGNITY LINE IS NOW A STATE THE DATABASE REFUSES TO HOLD WRONGLY.** The marker's closing sentence was that the protection above is "doctrine binding on authors, not yet a machine-checkable state". It is both halves of a mechanism now: a sibling-referencing column CHECK refuses a single-path determination that carries neither a named-path rationale nor a cultural anchor, and `derivation_handshake_integrity` checks the half a CHECK structurally cannot — that the anchor ANCHORS. `json_valid()` cannot tell a DPO position paper from a code document, a dead `ref_id`, or an empty list, and any of the three would satisfy the constraint and inherit the exemption by assertion, which is precisely what the boundary criterion above forbids. The check reads the anchor's own `co1_source_type` through G3's predicate.
150	
151	**ONE NARROWING, RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED OVER.** The boundary criterion anchors on "participatory peer-reviewed work" as well as `dpo_position_statement`. The column has a value for it, `participatory_research`, and `grain_for` grades it individual-grain, so such a claim owes the standard named-path rationale here instead of taking the exemption. That is the conservative direction on purpose: the cost is a sentence on a claim that would have been exempt, and the cost of erring the other way is every Co-1 claim inheriting the exemption by tier alone. Widening it is an owner decision made in `schemas.directness.grain_for()`, which the predicate reads, and it would also move the source's grain.
152	
153	**WHAT IS NOT YET PROVEN, because the corpus could not prove it — AND WHAT HAS SINCE CHANGED.** This paragraph read, until 2026-09-16: *"`specifications` still holds 0 rows — no parameter has been minted since the 2026-09-13 circulation clear, and the table cannot accept a row until one is."* All three clauses are now false. A parameter **was** minted on 2026-09-16, which is what made `specifications` writable, and the table has held rows ever since. **This sentence then said "it holds 2 rows", and by 2026-09-20 it held four times that** — so the correction of a stale count went stale itself, inside the paragraph whose whole subject is stale counts, exactly as rule 7a says it will. The number is not restated here. Derive both: `python3 -c "import sqlite3;c=sqlite3.connect('file:data/guidebook.db?mode=ro',uri=True);print({t:c.execute(f'select count(*) from {t}').fetchone()[0] for t in ('base_parameters','specifications')})"` and `PRAGMA table_info(specifications)` for the shape, per CLAUDE.md rule 7a.
154	
155	What the correction does **not** change: every branch above is still exercised by sixteen tests against a synthetic fixture and eight fault injections against a scratch copy rather than by a determination that has reached `stated` — both live rows are `pending`, and one is retired-and-superseded. So the coverage claim stands; only its stated cause was stale.
156	
157	`derivation_handshake_integrity` has taken **half** its ratchet as of 2026-09-16: `min_items: 1` is applied, because its subject is no longer empty. The `blocking` promotion the old sentence also names is deliberately **not** taken — changing what stops CI is a different decision from tightening a floor, and it is recorded in that check's `floor_basis` as an owner call rather than made silently inside a floor sweep.
158	
159	*This paragraph is a PROSE CALLER of the check registry, and CLAUDE.md rule 4 states plainly that prose callers are not covered by `schema_reference_audit` or any other gate. It went stale for exactly that reason, and was found by a hand sweep for readers of `no_floor`/`min_items` — not by a check. Anything else restating a registry claim carries the same risk.*
160	
161	## 6. Audiences — same determination, different register, never different data
162	
163	Audience structure (`governance/audience-priority.md`, CANONICAL): **primary** = designers and disabled people (production-use endpoints); **secondary** = occupational therapists and policymakers (intermediaries). Presentation (`armature_v4.md` §4.5): each role maps to an emphasis and a register — Designer/technical, OT/clinical, Policymaker/policy, Disabled person/plain-language, Carer/plain-language-care-context — under the hard rule: **role does not change the underlying data.**
164	
165	**Advocacy-brief use-pattern** `[NEW — DR-gated: G5]`. "Advocate" is not currently a named audience anywhere in canonical governance; `armature_v4.md` merges "disabled person / advocate" into one role. Resolution: advocacy is ratified as a **use-pattern within the disabled-person primary audience** (available by extension to carers and DPO staff), not a fifth audience. Its content need is real and distinct: the code-vs-best-practice **delta** ("the law requires 1800mm; the evidence supports 2440mm"), rights framing (CRPD-linked), and citable evidence strength — the policymaker rationale pattern with reversed valence. It inherits primary-audience priority (it belongs to a primary audience), which `audience-priority.md`'s conflict rules already handle; no restructuring of the four-audience architecture is needed, and the delta it foregrounds is computable (`v_code_floor` join per DR-2026-07-12 item 9).
166	
167	**The claim-strength register map** `[NEW — DR-gated: integrity mechanism]`. "Role changes register, never data" has until now been asserted, not testable. It becomes testable by making claim-strength language a **finite lookup, not free prose**: every rendering of a determination must draw its claim-strength language from a single map keyed by the determination tuple
168	
169	`(state, tier_basis, convergence, conditioning summary, regulatory_stratum_only)`
170	
171	with one language cell per register. Illustrative rows (the full map ships with the pilot and is versioned with `rule_version`):
172	
173	| Determination tuple | Technical register | Policy register | Plain-language register |
174	|---|---|---|---|
175	| `stated`, T1+Co-1, converge | "Best practice: X [●]. Clinical and lived-experience evidence converge." | "Evidence-based best practice X (convergent clinical + lived-experience basis); its relation to the code floor is stated only where extracted values support it." | "Research and disabled people's own experience both support X." |
176	| `stated`, Co-2 only | "Best practice: X [●] (OT professional-body guidance)." | "Best practice X per OT clinical practice guidelines; no independent trial evidence yet." | "Occupational-therapy professional guidance supports X. Research trials haven't tested this point yet." |
177	| `provisional`, `regulatory_stratum_only` | "Best practice as currently known: X [○ weak, code-derived]. Standards converge; **no anchoring evidence (T1/Co-1/T2/Co-2) exists for this cell** — convergence is not evidence." | "Best available given current regulation, NOT academically adjudicated: X [○]. Standards converge on X. **Convergence is not evidence** — no T1/Co-1/T2/Co-2 anchor exists; X stands as weak-band best practice only because nothing stronger says otherwise — the jurisdictions could all be wrong together." | "Building rules in several countries agree on X. **That's a rules answer, not a research answer:** no research and no lived-experience evidence yet shows what actually works best — X is just the most helpful value current rulebooks require, and it could change when real evidence arrives." |
178	| `pending` | "[BEST-PRACTICE-PENDING] — gap register →" | "[BEST-PRACTICE-PENDING] — evidence gap logged →" | "We don't know yet. This is an open gap we are tracking — not a settled answer." |
179	
180	Note the third row: the policymaker register — the one most tempted by convergence — carries the *strongest* anti-laundering language, not the weakest. Emphasis re-ranking (the `weighting_profile` mechanism, `workplan/best-practices-assessment-system.md` §5) chooses **which cells and columns are foregrounded** per audience; it can never move a rendering to a different row of this map.
181	
182	**The five integrity invariants** `[NEW — DR-gated: integrity mechanism]` — no mechanical check enforces them since `scripts/audit/register_integrity_check.py` was deleted (plan step 1.6, RULINGS R4); a check that comes back must be demonstrated firing on injected violations before its passes count (§10):
183	
184	- **I1 — Tuple identity.** Every rendering of a cell, in every register, carries the identical determination tuple. Different words, same facts.
185	- **I2 — Floor-anchor pairing.** Any rendering that shows a regulatory floor value alongside an evidence-anchored value must show both and label which is which; wherever an evidence-anchored value exists for the cell, the policymaker register must render the delta, never the floor alone. On a `regulatory_stratum_only` cell no anchored value (hence no delta) exists: the policymaker register renders the weak-band value under amended I3's mandatory flag and caveat, with the jurisdiction spread visible.
186	- **I3 (amended 2026-07-21, Option A — absolute form repealed) — Regulatory-stratum-only cells carry no *unflagged* and no *above-weak-band* best-practice language,** in any register, under any weighting profile. **Every rendering of such a cell's value — whether or not it uses best-practice phrasing —** must carry the weak/code-derived flag and the convergence-not-evidence caveat, and no rendering may exceed the register map's `(provisional, regulatory_stratum_only)` row (I5 applies with that row as ceiling; brevity under I5 may shorten wording but may never omit the flag or the caveat).
187	- **I4 — Marker translations are drawn only from the register map.** Plain-language translations of ●/◐/○ (`tier-system.md` §5) come from the map, not ad-hoc prose.
188	- **I5 — No register may express claim strength exceeding its map row.** A register may say *less* than the maximum (brevity), never *more* (inflation). Brevity never licenses omission of an integrity flag or caveat mandated by I3, G8, or the cell's map row.
189	
190	## 7. One vocabulary
191	
192	Three vocabularies currently name the design modes, and one of them collides catastrophically with the evidence tiers:
193	
194	| Deprecated usage | Where it appears | Canonical replacement |
195	|---|---|---|
196	| "Tier 1" / "Tier 2" *as design modes* | `mission-and-epistemics.md` commitment 4 table; `armature_v4.md` §4.6 output matrix ("Universal Mode / 1 / 2"); scattered prose | **Population Mode** / **Person Mode** |
197	| "Mode P" / "Mode S" | `evidence-methodology.md` §4; `armature_v4.md` §4.6 ("Mode S handoff") | **Population Mode** / **Person Mode** ("Person-Mode handoff") |  [RETIRED-VOCAB-OK]
198	| "Tier 1 range" (design sense) | OT use-pattern rows in `audience-priority.md` | "Population-Mode range" |
199	
200	`[NEW — DR-gated: vocabulary normalization]` **Universal Mode / Population Mode / Person Mode** become the sole canonical names for the design scales (matching `schemas/directness.py` SCALE_* values, which already use universal/population/person). "Tier N" is reserved exclusively for the evidence ladder. The unification DR's execution section lists the exact file-by-file edits; canonical documents are edited only after ratification. This collision is not cosmetic: it is the mechanical reason the architecture kept reading as contradictory — "Tier 2" simultaneously meant *systematic reviews*, *person-specific co-design*, and *OT CPGs* depending on the document.
201	
202	## 8. Worked examples — the architecture end-to-end
203	
204	**8.1 Corridor width (the canonical case, `tier-system.md` §3).** T5/T6 codes converge on 1800mm two-wheelchair passing; Co-1/T2/T3 evidence (Bauman 2010 DeafSpace, Vaughn 2018, Cloete & Rout 2025) anchors 2440mm primary corridors. — *Universal Mode:* floor = 1800mm (code-grain DIRECT); the population evidence justifies specifying above the floor. *Population Mode:* best practice 2440mm at anchoring strength; the 1800mm convergence is grain-directness NON-ANCHORING, and because anchoring-band evidence exists for this cell it is not `regulatory_stratum_only`, so amended I3's weak-band best-practice allowance never applies here: the map row for the anchored tuple contains no floor-as-best-practice language, and I1/I5 forbid exceeding it — so calling 1800mm "best practice" remains forbidden here in every register (weak-band code-derived phrasing exists only for cells with *no* anchoring evidence). *Person Mode:* no re-adjudication of the population value; assessment resolves the individual's own functional need, scaffolded by — not bounded by — the population range (e.g., a wheelchair user with a service animal, or two signing companions, may need the full 2440mm envelope, or more). — *Designer:* "2440mm best practice [●]; 1800mm regulatory floor (AS 1428.1 et al.)." *Policymaker:* the delta, with the convergence-not-evidence warning. *Disabled person:* "Research and Deaf-community experience support corridors wide enough for two people to sign side-by-side or two wheelchairs to pass — wider than the legal minimum." *Advocacy-brief:* "The law requires 1800mm; the evidence supports 2440mm. Citable sources: …" Same tuple in all four (I1).
205	
206	**8.2 Co-2-only cell (e.g., a home-modification parameter addressed by an RCOT/AOTA CPG, no trial evidence).** State `stated` per §2.2 condition 3; tuple (stated, Co-2, single). Every register discloses the basis honestly (map row 2): the claim is legitimate best practice *and* its evidence character is visible — rigour and usability are not traded off.
207	
208	**8.3 T4/T5-only cell (the decisive G1 test).** ISO + BS convergence on a parameter, zero T1/Co-1/T2/Co-2. Pre-G1: `provisional`, rendered "standards converge on X," policymaker profile up-weights it — laundering. Post-G1: `provisional` + `regulatory_stratum_only`; every register uses map row 3. Post-Option-A (owner directive 2026-07-21): the cell surfaces in `v_best_practice` as a queryably distinct weak-band (○) code-derived best-practice determination (landed: migration 029's `strength_band`, replaced by the row's `marker` in migration 116) — rendered "best practice as currently known" with the mandatory weak/code-derived flag and convergence-not-evidence caveat; where the ISO and BS floors differ, the direction-aware most-accommodating value anchors (§5); the confidence flag names the absent anchoring dimensions; the cell still appears in the gap register as needing anchoring evidence. If the standard's own evidence base is later documented as traceable to T1/T2, the G1 re-graining rule admits it as GRAIN_AGGREGATE — with provenance recorded, not assumed.
209	
210	**8.4 Co-1/T1 divergence at Person Mode (entrance threshold, `evidence-methodology.md` §4).** Where clinical evidence and lived-experience evidence diverge on a parameter, the divergence is recorded and a synthesis approach is required and rendered (never hidden). At Person Mode the asymmetry principle governs: the person's own assessed need — not the population median, not the DPO position, not the CPG — resolves the value; the population range informs the assessment but does not bound it. The OT register presents the functional parameter and the population-range scaffold the assessment starts from; the plain-language register tells the person what is theirs to decide.
211	
212	## 9. Academic rigour and ethics — the standing commitments
213	
214	**Rigour.** The architecture's methodological anchors, and where each is argued in full: correspondence to GRADE/JBI/SIGN and why wholesale GRADE adoption is insufficient for built-environment claims (`references/methodology-evidence-hierarchy-mapping.md` v2 — the directness layer *is* GRADE's indirectness domain, applied bidirectionally; synthesis-above-primary follows GRADE; the co-primacy of lived experience is a declared, argued departure, not an oversight); categorical rather than numeric conditioning (no false-precision scores, `schemas/directness.py` BOUNDARY note); determinism and reproducibility (pure determination function, `rule_version` + `derivation_sha`); falsifiability (every `stated`/`provisional` cell records what evidence would overturn it, `workplan/best-practices-assessment-system.md` §3 item 6); absence-of-evidence ≠ evidence-of-absence (Altman & Bland 1995, applied to cells in §2.4 and — via G2 — to the project's own assessment metadata); and the anti-hallucination gate (no determination without resolvable `governing_refs`).
215	
216	**Ethics.** The commitments are structural, not aspirational: CRPD Art. 4.3 grounds Co-1 co-primacy (Art. 9 ≈ Universal Mode floor; Art. 5 reasonable accommodation ≈ Person Mode; the full article-by-article critique is `governance/armature_v3_review.md`); epistemic justice is engineered — testimonial justice via Co-1's non-substitutable co-primacy and G3's refusal to let population-grain speech stand in for individuals, hermeneutical justice via the plain-language register receiving the *same* determination tuple as the technical one (I1: access to the same facts, not a simplified sub-truth); the carer is a distinct role, never a proxy for the disabled person (Art. 12 supported-not-substituted decision-making, `armature_v4.md` §4.5); representation-checking by disabled readers is an elevated-weight use-pattern whose failure overrides designer convenience (`audience-priority.md` §Within-primary); and the solo-authorship limit is declared on every Co-1-governed determination — pre-launch engagement with Co-1 is evidence-level, not participation-level, and CRPD Art. 4.3 is thereby honored in partial form only (`mission-and-epistemics.md` §Operational reality). Integrity here means the limits are rendered, not just recorded.
217	
218	## 10. What would falsify this architecture, and how it is checked
219	
220	**Mechanical checks (each must be shown firing on injected bad data before its pass counts):**
221	1. *Matrix–code consistency:* the sweep below regenerates §3's parenthesized outcomes from `schemas/directness.py` for all grain × scale combinations; any diff fails.
222	2. *Determinism:* the pilot engine run twice over the same evidence set yields byte-identical `derivation_sha` values.
223	3. *Invariants I1–I5:* over rendered output; unenforced (the check was deleted, plan step 1.6).
224	4. *State-machine integrity:* `scripts/validate_evidence_state.py` (governing_refs non-empty; `code_floor_only`/`regulatory_stratum_only` never `stated`; Tier-3-alone threshold).
225	
226	```python
227	# Matrix–code consistency sweep (§3). Run from repo root: python -c "…" or scripts/audit/matrix_consistency.py
228	from schemas.directness import (ALL_GRAINS, ALL_SCALES, scale_directness)
229	for grain in sorted(ALL_GRAINS):
230	    for scale in sorted(ALL_SCALES):
231	        print(f"{grain:>10} × {scale:<11} -> {scale_directness(grain, scale)}")
232	# Expected (must match §3's parentheses): aggregate×population DIRECT; aggregate×person DOWN-WEIGHTED;
233	# aggregate×universal ADJACENT; code×universal DIRECT; code×population NON-ANCHORING; code×person NON-ANCHORING;
234	# specific×person DIRECT; specific×population DIRECT (DOWN-WEIGHTED if generalizes_beyond_measured); specific×universal ADJACENT.
235	```
236	
237	**Falsification conditions (doctrinal):** this architecture is wrong if — a rendering pipeline honoring I1–I5 cannot serve a named audience's canonical use-pattern without breaching an invariant (audience needs and integrity actually conflict); or a real cell arises whose correct handling requires re-ranking the ladder per mode rather than conditioning it (D-D's core is false); or representation-checking by disabled readers returns systematic "this is wrong about my experience" verdicts on determinations the machinery marks sound (the machinery measures the wrong thing). Any of these routes to a DR, not a silent patch.
238	
239	---
240	
241	## Status
242	
243	| Field | Value |
244	|---|---|
245	| Created | 2026-07-12 |
246	| Status | CANONICAL — ratified 2026-07-13 (`decisions/RATIFICATION-RECORD-2026-07-13.md`); amended 2026-07-21 by owner directive, Option A weak-anchor reconciliation (`decisions/DR-2026-07-21-evidence-architecture-option-a-execution.md`); amended 2026-08-15 with §4.5 and §5.5, the integration this document was ratified as owing (below) |
247	| New-doctrine items | G1 (re-graining + `regulatory_stratum_only` + scale-tagging), G2 (NOT_ASSESSED), G3 (Co-1 grain by source type), G4 (asymmetry principle, declarative), G5 (advocacy-brief use-pattern), G6 (grain from type × tier), G7 (`stated` threshold admits T2 anchors explicitly), G8 (`pending_assessment` renders with mandatory disclosure), register map + invariants I1–I5, vocabulary normalization; **§4.5 genealogy (H1) and §5.5 the derivation handshake incl. the cultural-claim protection (H2–H4)** |
248	| 2026-08-15 amendment | §4.5 + §5.5 added, executing the "Affects" line of `DR-2026-07-13-value-genealogy-and-derivation-handshake` — *"`governance/evidence-architecture.md` (gains §4.5 genealogy + §5.5 handshake on ratification)"*. The DR was ratified 2026-07-13 and this integration was tracked as **Q22** in `workplan/ratification-execution-register-2026-07-13.md`, having been found by that ratification's own adversarial pass and then left undone for a month: H2's cultural-claim protection was ratified as a *named owner commitment* while the document declared CANONICAL at the same moment said nothing about it. Doctrine text only — no engine or schema change rides with this edit, and the build state of each item is marked in place. |
249	| Everything else | Restatement with citation; source documents govern |
250	| Author | Claude, at owner request; adversarially reviewed pre-proposal (see DR revision history) |

# Evidence Architecture — the unified statement
**Status:** CANONICAL — ratified by owner directive 2026-07-13 (see `decisions/RATIFICATION-RECORD-2026-07-13.md`); the single entry point to the evidence architecture per `decisions/DR-2026-07-12-evidence-architecture-unification.md` (ACCEPTED). **Amended 2026-07-21 by owner directive (finding F1, Option A):** reconciled to the weighted-strength anchor model of `governance/tier-system.md` §8 — regulatory-stratum-only determinations anchor best practice at the weak band, always flagged; direction-aware most-accommodating floor selection added (§5). Execution record: `decisions/DR-2026-07-21-evidence-architecture-option-a-execution.md`.
**Created:** 2026-07-12
**Character:** Index-and-synthesis. ## 1. Why this document exists

The project has repeatedly re-encountered one question as if unresolved: *how can a single evidence hierarchy dynamically weight evidence by design mode (universal / population / person), and present differently per audience, without compromising intellectual integrity?*

The answer exists. It was decided incrementally — T-03/T-04 (Stage 0.5), A5/A6 (April 2026), the owner directive of 2026-05-25, decision D-D and DR-2026-05-29 (May 2026), the armature v4 role layer, and the Stage 2.2 directness build — but it was never stated in one place, and three colliding vocabularies made the fragments look inconsistent when they were not (§7). This document is the one place.

## 2. One ladder

There is exactly **one** evidence hierarchy: tiers T1–T6 with two co-primary community-knowledge tracks (`governance/tier-system.md` §1). Its governing principle: **tier reflects what kind of claim a source can anchor, not how good the source is.**

- **T1** — primary research with intervention-level or biomechanical control; OT-prioritized, not OT-exclusive (decision D-E).
- **Co-1** — disability-led lived-experience evidence (CRPD Art. 4.3), **co-primary with T1**: primary-research evidence and lived-experience evidence are non-substitutable on different claim types. T1 anchors claims that turn on mechanism; Co-1 anchors claims that turn on user-stated preference, dignity, autonomy, self-determined accommodation.
- **T2** — synthesis: (a) systematic reviews / meta-analyses; (b) named-organisation evidence-based standards. **Co-2** — OT professional-body CPGs, co-primary with T2.
- **T3** — lower-control primary clinical + grey-literature primary research; supporting, rarely sole basis (threshold for T3-alone `stated`: `decisions/DR-2026-07-12-tier3-stated-threshold.md`).
- **T4–T6** — the **regulatory stratum**: international standards, national beyond-code frameworks, statutory codes. Valid for code-baseline claims and jurisdiction tracking. Under the weighted-strength anchor model (`tier-system.md` §8, superseding §3's binary wall; owner directive 2026-07-21, Option A) **they anchor best-practice claims only at weak weighted strength**: where no anchoring-band evidence (T1/Co-1/T2/Co-2, T3 per its threshold DR) exists, the regulatory value is stated as best practice *as currently known, given that nothing stronger says otherwise* — always flagged weak/code-derived, never unflagged, with the convergence-not-evidence caveat intact: convergence of codes is convergence-not-evidence — the jurisdictions could all be wrong together, or all be copying one unevidenced ancestor.

The ladder never re-ranks. Nothing in this architecture — no design mode, no audience, no weighting profile — reorders these tiers. What varies is *conditioning* (§4) and *emphasis* (§6), never rank.

## 3. Three modes, one asymmetry principle

The three design modes (`mission-and-epistemics.md` commitment 4, names normalized per §7):

| Mode | Function | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| **Universal Mode** | Universal design / code compliance — the floor, not an aspiration | Population-agnostic; fixed values |
| **Population Mode** | Population-informed inclusive design | Ranges; median as default |
| **Person Mode** | Person-specific co-design | OT co-design resolves the individual's own specific functional needs — their circumstances, capabilities, impairments, and comorbidities; the design answers may be informed by a related disability population, but that population does not bound the answer, which may fall outside any population range |

Evidence tier and design mode are **orthogonal axes of coverage** — both always consulted, neither determining the other (`evidence-methodology.md` §1.4). But orthogonality is *scale-conditioned* (decision D-D, §1.6): the ladder is consulted at every scale while its adjudicating force is asymmetric.

**The asymmetry principle** `[NEW — DR-gated: G4]` — the single sentence that unifies D-D:

> **At each design scale, the anchoring authority is the entity whose grain *is* that scale: at Universal Mode, the code (the only place code-grain evidence is direct); at Population Mode, the aggregate evidence ladder (the only place source-ranking does its substantive adjudication); at Person Mode, the person themselves — in OT-supported co-design, the in-situ analogue of Co-1 co-primacy — with published evidence conditioning the assessment *process*, never overriding the assessed answer.**

This is not new machinery; it is the already-ratified content of §1.6 plus `co1-operational.md`'s Person-scale rule, stated positively. Its corollaries, all already canonical: Universal Mode uses source-ranking only to justify exceeding the floor; the Population range is where the hierarchy adjudicates values; Person Mode asks a different evidence question (assessment and clinical-reasoning evidence), so the parameter-value ladder does not re-run there, and no population-level source — including population-grain Co-1 — overrides an individual's assessed position.

Grain assignments marked † change under G3/G6 (§4); the matrix shows the **post-G3/G6** state, which is the state the pilot engine implements.

## 4. Directness — the conditioning layer

Directness conditions the weight a source carries for a given claim, as a categorical layer over the single ladder — never a separate hierarchy per scale, never a numeric confidence score (`evidence-methodology.md` §1.7; `schemas/directness.py`). Three dimensions: population-directness (EXACT/PARTIAL/PROXY/MISMATCH), value-directness (EXACT/WITHIN-TOLERANCE/NOT-FOUND/CONTRADICTED), scale-directness (DIRECT/ADJACENT/DOWN-WEIGHTED/NON-ANCHORING). They consolidate to one conditioning grade: DIRECT / DOWN-WEIGHTED / DISCOUNTED / NON-ANCHORING. The principle is **grain-matching, not specificity-ranking** — bidirectional per GRADE's directness (indirectness) domain: an aggregate systematic review is strongest for a population claim and down-weighted for a person-specific claim; a direct intervention study is the reverse.

Four refinements close gaps found by adversarial review (2026-07-12); each is a separately ratifiable DR item:

**G1 — Re-graining rule for T4/T5** `[NEW — DR-gated]`. `tier-system.md` §1 already says T4/T5 sources can support best-practice claims "if the standard itself rests on T1/T2 evidence." This document operationalizes that clause: a T4/T5 source is assigned `GRAIN_AGGREGATE` (and thereby escapes NON-ANCHORING at Population Mode) **only** when its evidence basis is documented as traceable to T1/T2 evidence, with that provenance recorded on the source record. Otherwise it keeps `GRAIN_CODE`. Untraceable standards convergence stays in the regulatory stratum where §2 put it.

**G2 — NOT_ASSESSED is not EXACT** `[NEW — DR-gated]`. `consolidate()` currently treats a `None` population-directness as "not applicable — does not block," which is correct for claims where the dimension genuinely does not apply, but only 27 of 640 sources carry any `evidence_population_match` row — so at backfill scale, "never assessed" would silently grade as fully direct. The engine distinguishes **NOT_ASSESSED** (dimension applies, no assessment exists) from **not-applicable** (dimension genuinely inapplicable). A NOT_ASSESSED dimension caps consolidation at DOWN-WEIGHTED and flags the source for assessment. Absence of assessment is never treated as evidence of directness — the Altman & Bland distinction (`evidence-methodology.md` §2.4) applied to the project's own metadata.

**G3 — Co-1 grain follows `co1_source_type`** `[NEW — DR-gated]`. Co-1 is not uniform in grain: `dpo_position_statement` is population-grain community knowledge (→ GRAIN_AGGREGATE); `lived_experience_publication`, `participatory_research` and individual-testimony corpora are individual-grain (→ GRAIN_SPECIFIC), which is also what `grain_for` gives any value it does not name. The column declares no CHECK; `schemas.enums.Co1SourceType` is its vocabulary (RULINGS R11). This makes the matrix row-pair in §3 mechanical, and it encodes the ethical rule already in `co1-operational.md`: a DPO position paper is community consensus — it anchors Population-Mode claims *and does not override an individual at Person Mode*; an individual narrative is the reverse.

**G6 — Grain derives from (evidence_type × tier), not evidence_type alone** `[NEW — DR-gated]`. `standard_eb` spans two strata: T2 named-organisation evidence-based standards (synthesis-tier — the "same epistemic move as sr_meta, different machinery," `tier-system.md` §2) and T4 international standards (regulatory stratum). The current type-only default grains both as CODE, which would make T2 DPO/professional-body standards NON-ANCHORING at Population Mode — contradicting `evidence-methodology.md` §1.6, which lists Tier 2 among the anchoring strata. Resolution: `standard_eb` at T2 → GRAIN_AGGREGATE; `standard_eb` at T4/T5 → GRAIN_CODE (unless re-grained per G1). Grain assignment is a function of the (type, tier) pair.

### 4.5 Genealogy — counting roots, not documents

Directness conditions how much a source's *claim* weighs. Genealogy conditions how much a value's *apparent agreement* weighs. It gives the project's central adjudication — best practice versus consensus — a computable form. `[H1 — DR-2026-07-13-value-genealogy-and-derivation-handshake, ratified 2026-07-13]`

The doctrine in one line: **precedent counts documents; evidence counts roots.** Twenty-four jurisdictions specifying the same figure is one fact about transmission, not twenty-four facts about disabled people. This is the §2 convergence-not-evidence rule pushed one level down — from *which stratum is agreeing?* to *how many independent measurements are they all agreeing about?* The corridor case is the worked proof (§8.1; `references/methodology/value-genealogy-worked-example-corridor-width.md`): 1500mm turning "circles" across 24 jurisdictions trace to a single 1970s anthropometric root whose own authors record it as needing updating; the 1800mm passing consensus has no traceable root anywhere in the corpus; 2440/2400mm has two independent roots (ASL proxemics, Co-1; swept-path anthropometry, T3) plus one untraced regulatory convergence.

**Storage.** Each extracted value on `source_value_extractions` carries `root_id`, `root_type` (`measurement_primary` / `participatory_finding` / `committee_assertion` / `derived_calculation` / `untraced`), `root_ref_id`, `echo_of`, `measurement_paradigm`, `device_class`, `root_population_note`, `file_anchor`, `root_classification_basis`, `contested`. The discriminator is the view `v_value_independence`: independent roots **per parameter**, counting DISTINCT roots and excluding `committee_assertion`. *(Swept 2026-09-10 with migration 073, which names this file as a prose caller of that view. The sentence read "per (parameter, population)"; the population half went with migration 071, which took `population_code` out of the view's grain, and 073 re-derived the view a second time onto `parameter_id`. It groups by `parameter_id` alone — the lens is the determination's, not the root count's.)*

**Three anti-gaming disciplines, structural rather than editorial.** (a) *Root registry* — a `root_id` must resolve either to a `root_ref_id` in `evidence_sources` or to a registered external-root stub, so two extractors cannot mint two ids for one root and double the count. (b) *Untraced rows carry NULL `root_id` and are excluded from the count* — untraceability can never out-score a traced chain. (c) *`root_classification_basis` + `contested`* — the root-versus-echo judgment is recordably disputable, not free-text folklore.

**AMENDED** 2026-10-14 in the first alternative of discipline (a), by `references/project-standards.md`: "the rule becomes that `source_value_extractions.root_id` references `external_root_registry` and nothing else". A `root_id` names a registered external root; a root held in `evidence_sources` is named by `root_ref_id`. The rest of this paragraph stands. See the ledger entry "Recording 2026-10-14, third part".

**The six adjudication tests — four encoded, two doctrinal.** Root, Independence, Paradigm-commensurability and Fit-population map onto the fields above. *Currency* rides the existing supersession machinery (`evidence_sources.superseded_by_ref_id` + DR-2026-05-24) rather than duplicating it. *Interest* — who convened the consensus? — is recorded in `root_classification_basis` notes: doctrinal, not a column, until a real vocabulary for convening-interest emerges from use. Cross-paradigm and cross-device-class applications are recorded as **derivations, never identities**: a static turning circle cannot corroborate a swept-path envelope (most real turns are asymmetric spin turns; scooters have no pivot at all), and a figure a source declares manual-wheelchair-only does not silently become a power-chair figure.

## 5. Determinations — states, and what each state is *about*

Each (`parameter_id` × at least one of `identity_code`, `icf_code`, `needs_code`) cell holds one of four states (`evidence-methodology.md` §2; storage: migration 026): `stated`, `provisional`, `pending`, `not_applicable`. The determination is written by a pure function — same evidence + same `rule_version` ⇒ same state and same `derivation_sha` (`workplan/best-practices-assessment-system.md` §3) — and no `stated` or `provisional` determination can exist without non-empty `governing_refs` (anti-hallucination, DR-2026-07-12 item 10; `pending`/`not_applicable` rows carry a gap link or rationale instead).

**Scale-tagging** `[NEW — DR-gated: G1b]`. Every determination is tagged with the design scale its claim speaks to, and the tag governs what the determination may be *called* in every rendering:

- A determination anchored in T1/Co-1/T2/Co-2 (with T3 per its threshold DR) is a **Population-Mode best-practice determination** — the only kind rendered at anchoring strength (`●` band, subject to its conditioning). Since the weighted-strength amendment (owner directive 2026-07-21, Option A; `tier-system.md` §8) the phrase "best practice" is no longer exclusive to it: the weak band below extends the phrase, never the strength (the ◐ band applies at citation level only — footnote ††).
- A determination whose entire basis is the regulatory stratum (T4–6) is a **Universal-Mode regulatory determination**, flagged `regulatory_stratum_only` (extending migration 026's `code_floor_only`, which covers only the T6-only case, to the full T4–6-only case). It answers "what does the harmonised/statutory floor specify?" — and, per owner directive 2026-07-21 (Option A), it **is a best-practice determination at the weak band (○)**: best available *as currently known, given that nothing stronger says otherwise*. It renders in every register, for every audience, **only** flagged weak/code-derived with the convergence-not-evidence caveat — never unflagged, never at anchoring strength (amended I3, §6); its state remains `provisional`, never `stated`. `v_best_practice` includes it as a queryably distinct weak-band row, carrying the row's `marker` (migration 116, which replaced the `strength_band` column of migration 029). This sentence previously read "today the view still excludes `regulatory_stratum_only` rows … and no strength-band column exists", which migration 029 had already made false. The `provisional` confidence flag still names the absent anchoring dimensions (`evidence-methodology.md` §2.3's flag, with teeth at T4/T5, not just T6).
- **Most-accommodating floor selection (direction-aware)** `[Option A, owner directive 2026-07-21]`. Where jurisdictions' code floors differ on a parameter, the regulatory-stratum determination anchors on the **most accommodating available value, read per the parameter's accessibility direction** — best-for-the-user, not largest-number: the widest minimum corridor, but the *lowest* maximum threshold height and the *gentlest* maximum ramp slope. The parameter's direction is to be recorded with the determination, and the passed-over floors remain visible as the jurisdiction spread (they are code-baseline facts, not discarded evidence). **Where the accessibility direction is population-contested** — e.g. flush thresholds aid wheeled mobility but remove the tactile cues cane users rely on; heavy acoustic absorption aids hearing-aid users but degrades echolocation; brighter light aids low vision but harms photosensitive users — **most-accommodating selection is inapplicable: no single value is anchored; the conflict is recorded via the conflicts machinery, and the jurisdiction spread is rendered with each population's direction stated** (suppressing the divergence would itself be an error, `mission-and-epistemics.md`). `[LANDED 2026-09-13 — migrations 078/079 and `assess_cell.compose_value()`. All three items that marker named now exist: per-parameter accessibility-direction metadata (`base_parameters.accessibility_direction`, with its rationale required by the schema and written by `db.py set-parameter-direction`), direction-aware selection (the widest minimum under `higher_is_better`, the lowest under `lower_is_better`), and a `contested` state that declines to anchor any value. Where the engine cannot compose a value it records WHY in `specifications.value_note`, so a contested direction is distinguishable from an unrecorded one — the four decline-reasons were all a bare NULL before 079. Verified by driving the engine over the same two divergent governing claims under each direction: `higher_is_better` selected 10, `lower_is_better` selected 4. DR-2026-07-21 §5: markers are removed only by the follow-up that lands the behavior.]`
- Person Mode produces no stored determinations at all: the assessed answer addresses the individual's own specific functional needs — their circumstances, capabilities, impairments, and comorbidities — and may be *informed by* a related disability population without being *bounded by* it (§3); a resolved value may fall outside any population range, and comorbid or hard-to-classify presentations routinely require exactly that. What the guidebook stores for Person Mode is the *handoff* — the functional parameter driving assessment and the population-range scaffold the assessment starts from (`armature_v4.md` §4.6 "Mode S handoff" — vocabulary normalized to "Person-Mode handoff" per §7). ### 5.5 The derivation handshake — and the cultural-claim protection

The corpus derives values along two paths that have never been required to meet: **top-down** from population and community (BPCs, Co-1, every population join) and **bottom-up** from function (the ICF-indexed `references/fdr/` corpus, deliberately population-blind at collection; the functional-deficit-auditor's population↔ICF mapping, which lived as unvalidated skill prose until migration 080 promoted it into the table now named `identity_icf_map` on 2026-09-13). No mechanism requires the paths to agree before a value ships, and dual derivation is undetectable by query. `[H2–H4 — DR-2026-07-13-value-genealogy-and-derivation-handshake, ratified 2026-07-13]`

**The rule.** Every determination records `functional_basis` (mechanism type per the FDA taxonomy, ICF code(s), and supporting refs including FDR file anchors) and `derivation_paths` ∈ `dual` / `population_only` / `function_only`. Dual-path convergence is recorded as itself evidence — doctrine #3, convergence across independent axes, extended from evidence axes to derivation paths. A single-path assertion is permitted **only with a named-path rationale**, in the exact shape of the existing `single_axis` rule.

**The cultural/dignity-claim protection — a named commitment, ratified 2026-07-13.** Claims whose normative force is community-rooted remain **fully assertable as `population_only`**. The handshake makes a derivation *explicit*; it never requires a mechanism where the claim is cultural, and **no functional derivation may flatten, reduce, or override a community claim** — there is no bottom-up override of Co-1. This was ratified as a named commitment rather than inherited silently, because it is the dignity line the architecture exists to hold: it binds every register, every audience, and the engine. ## 6. Audiences — same determination, different register, never different data

Audience structure (`governance/audience-priority.md`, CANONICAL): **primary** = designers and disabled people (production-use endpoints); **secondary** = occupational therapists and policymakers (intermediaries). Presentation (`armature_v4.md` §4.5): each role maps to an emphasis and a register — Designer/technical, OT/clinical, Policymaker/policy, Disabled person/plain-language, Carer/plain-language-care-context — under the hard rule: **role does not change the underlying data.**

**Advocacy-brief use-pattern** `[NEW — DR-gated: G5]`. "Advocate" is not currently a named audience anywhere in canonical governance; `armature_v4.md` merges "disabled person / advocate" into one role. Resolution: advocacy is ratified as a **use-pattern within the disabled-person primary audience** (available by extension to carers and DPO staff), not a fifth audience. Its content need is real and distinct: the code-vs-best-practice **delta** ("the law requires 1800mm; the evidence supports 2440mm"), rights framing (CRPD-linked), and citable evidence strength — the policymaker rationale pattern with reversed valence. It inherits primary-audience priority (it belongs to a primary audience), which `audience-priority.md`'s conflict rules already handle; no restructuring of the four-audience architecture is needed, and the delta it foregrounds is computable (`v_code_floor` join per DR-2026-07-12 item 9).

**The claim-strength register map** `[NEW — DR-gated: integrity mechanism]`. "Role changes register, never data" has until now been asserted, not testable. It becomes testable by making claim-strength language a **finite lookup, not free prose**: every rendering of a determination must draw its claim-strength language from a single map keyed by the determination tuple

`(state, tier_basis, convergence, conditioning summary, regulatory_stratum_only)`

with one language cell per register. Illustrative rows (the full map ships with the pilot and is versioned with `rule_version`):

Note the third row: the policymaker register — the one most tempted by convergence — carries the *strongest* anti-laundering language, not the weakest. Emphasis re-ranking (the `weighting_profile` mechanism, `workplan/best-practices-assessment-system.md` §5) chooses **which cells and columns are foregrounded** per audience; it can never move a rendering to a different row of this map.

**The five integrity invariants** `[NEW — DR-gated: integrity mechanism]` — no mechanical check enforces them since `scripts/audit/register_integrity_check.py` was deleted (plan step 1.6, RULINGS R4); a check that comes back must be demonstrated firing on injected violations before its passes count (§10):

- **I2 — Floor-anchor pairing.** Any rendering that shows a regulatory floor value alongside an evidence-anchored value must show both and label which is which; wherever an evidence-anchored value exists for the cell, the policymaker register must render the delta, never the floor alone. On a `regulatory_stratum_only` cell no anchored value (hence no delta) exists: the policymaker register renders the weak-band value under amended I3's mandatory flag and caveat, with the jurisdiction spread visible.

## 7. One vocabulary

Three vocabularies currently name the design modes, and one of them collides catastrophically with the evidence tiers:

| Deprecated usage | Where it appears | Canonical replacement |
|---|---|---|
| "Tier 1" / "Tier 2" *as design modes* | `mission-and-epistemics.md` commitment 4 table; `armature_v4.md` §4.6 output matrix ("Universal Mode / 1 / 2"); scattered prose | **Population Mode** / **Person Mode** |
| "Mode P" / "Mode S" | `evidence-methodology.md` §4; `armature_v4.md` §4.6 ("Mode S handoff") | **Population Mode** / **Person Mode** ("Person-Mode handoff") |  [RETIRED-VOCAB-OK]
| "Tier 1 range" (design sense) | OT use-pattern rows in `audience-priority.md` | "Population-Mode range" |

`[NEW — DR-gated: vocabulary normalization]` **Universal Mode / Population Mode / Person Mode** become the sole canonical names for the design scales (matching `schemas/directness.py` SCALE_* values, which already use universal/population/person). "Tier N" is reserved exclusively for the evidence ladder. The unification DR's execution section lists the exact file-by-file edits; canonical documents are edited only after ratification. This collision is not cosmetic: it is the mechanical reason the architecture kept reading as contradictory — "Tier 2" simultaneously meant *systematic reviews*, *person-specific co-design*, and *OT CPGs* depending on the document.

## 8. Worked examples — the architecture end-to-end

**8.1 Corridor width (the canonical case, `tier-system.md` §3).** T5/T6 codes converge on 1800mm two-wheelchair passing; Co-1/T2/T3 evidence (Bauman 2010 DeafSpace, Vaughn 2018, Cloete & Rout 2025) anchors 2440mm primary corridors. — *Universal Mode:* floor = 1800mm (code-grain DIRECT); the population evidence justifies specifying above the floor. *Population Mode:* best practice 2440mm at anchoring strength; the 1800mm convergence is grain-directness NON-ANCHORING, and because anchoring-band evidence exists for this cell it is not `regulatory_stratum_only`, so amended I3's weak-band best-practice allowance never applies here: the map row for the anchored tuple contains no floor-as-best-practice language, and I1/I5 forbid exceeding it — so calling 1800mm "best practice" remains forbidden here in every register (weak-band code-derived phrasing exists only for cells with *no* anchoring evidence). *Person Mode:* no re-adjudication of the population value; assessment resolves the individual's own functional need, scaffolded by — not bounded by — the population range (e.g., a wheelchair user with a service animal, or two signing companions, may need the full 2440mm envelope, or more). — *Designer:* "2440mm best practice [●]; 1800mm regulatory floor (AS 1428.1 et al.)." *Policymaker:* the delta, with the convergence-not-evidence warning. *Disabled person:* "Research and Deaf-community experience support corridors wide enough for two people to sign side-by-side or two wheelchairs to pass — wider than the legal minimum." *Advocacy-brief:* "The law requires 1800mm; the evidence supports 2440mm. Citable sources: …" Same tuple in all four (I1).

**8.2 Co-2-only cell (e.g., a home-modification parameter addressed by an RCOT/AOTA CPG, no trial evidence).** State `stated` per §2.2 condition 3; tuple (stated, Co-2, single). Every register discloses the basis honestly (map row 2): the claim is legitimate best practice *and* its evidence character is visible — rigour and usability are not traded off.

**8.3 T4/T5-only cell (the decisive G1 test).** ISO + BS convergence on a parameter, zero T1/Co-1/T2/Co-2. Pre-G1: `provisional`, rendered "standards converge on X," policymaker profile up-weights it — laundering. Post-G1: `provisional` + `regulatory_stratum_only`; every register uses map row 3. Post-Option-A (owner directive 2026-07-21): the cell surfaces in `v_best_practice` as a queryably distinct weak-band (○) code-derived best-practice determination (landed: migration 029's `strength_band`, replaced by the row's `marker` in migration 116) — rendered "best practice as currently known" with the mandatory weak/code-derived flag and convergence-not-evidence caveat; where the ISO and BS floors differ, the direction-aware most-accommodating value anchors (§5); the confidence flag names the absent anchoring dimensions; the cell still appears in the gap register as needing anchoring evidence. If the standard's own evidence base is later documented as traceable to T1/T2, the G1 re-graining rule admits it as GRAIN_AGGREGATE — with provenance recorded, not assumed.

**8.4 Co-1/T1 divergence at Person Mode (entrance threshold, `evidence-methodology.md` §4).** Where clinical evidence and lived-experience evidence diverge on a parameter, the divergence is recorded and a synthesis approach is required and rendered (never hidden). At Person Mode the asymmetry principle governs: the person's own assessed need — not the population median, not the DPO position, not the CPG — resolves the value; the population range informs the assessment but does not bound it. The OT register presents the functional parameter and the population-range scaffold the assessment starts from; the plain-language register tells the person what is theirs to decide.

## 9. Academic rigour and ethics — the standing commitments

**Rigour.** The architecture's methodological anchors, and where each is argued in full: correspondence to GRADE/JBI/SIGN and why wholesale GRADE adoption is insufficient for built-environment claims (`references/methodology-evidence-hierarchy-mapping.md` v2 — the directness layer *is* GRADE's indirectness domain, applied bidirectionally; synthesis-above-primary follows GRADE; the co-primacy of lived experience is a declared, argued departure, not an oversight); categorical rather than numeric conditioning (no false-precision scores, `schemas/directness.py` BOUNDARY note); determinism and reproducibility (pure determination function, `rule_version` + `derivation_sha`); falsifiability (every `stated`/`provisional` cell records what evidence would overturn it, `workplan/best-practices-assessment-system.md` §3 item 6); absence-of-evidence ≠ evidence-of-absence (Altman & Bland 1995, applied to cells in §2.4 and — via G2 — to the project's own assessment metadata); and the anti-hallucination gate (no determination without resolvable `governing_refs`).

**Ethics.** The commitments are structural, not aspirational: CRPD Art. 4.3 grounds Co-1 co-primacy (Art. 9 ≈ Universal Mode floor; Art. 5 reasonable accommodation ≈ Person Mode; the full article-by-article critique is `governance/armature_v3_review.md`); epistemic justice is engineered — testimonial justice via Co-1's non-substitutable co-primacy and G3's refusal to let population-grain speech stand in for individuals, hermeneutical justice via the plain-language register receiving the *same* determination tuple as the technical one (I1: access to the same facts, not a simplified sub-truth); the carer is a distinct role, never a proxy for the disabled person (Art. 12 supported-not-substituted decision-making, `armature_v4.md` §4.5); representation-checking by disabled readers is an elevated-weight use-pattern whose failure overrides designer convenience (`audience-priority.md` §Within-primary); and the solo-authorship limit is declared on every Co-1-governed determination — pre-launch engagement with Co-1 is evidence-level, not participation-level, and CRPD Art. 4.3 is thereby honored in partial form only (`mission-and-epistemics.md` §Operational reality). Integrity here means the limits are rendered, not just recorded.

## 10. What would falsify this architecture, and how it is checked

**Mechanical checks (each must be shown firing on injected bad data before its pass counts):**
1. *Matrix–code consistency:* the sweep below regenerates §3's parenthesized outcomes from `schemas/directness.py` for all grain × scale combinations; any diff fails.
2. *Determinism:* the pilot engine run twice over the same evidence set yields byte-identical `derivation_sha` values.
3. *Invariants I1–I5:* over rendered output; unenforced (the check was deleted, plan step 1.6).
4. *State-machine integrity:* `scripts/validate_evidence_state.py` (governing_refs non-empty; `code_floor_only`/`regulatory_stratum_only` never `stated`; Tier-3-alone threshold).

```python
# Matrix–code consistency sweep (§3). Run from repo root: python -c "…" or scripts/audit/matrix_consistency.py
from schemas.directness import (ALL_GRAINS, ALL_SCALES, scale_directness)
for grain in sorted(ALL_GRAINS):
    for scale in sorted(ALL_SCALES):
        print(f"{grain:>10} × {scale:<11} -> {scale_directness(grain, scale)}")
# Expected (must match §3's parentheses): aggregate×population DIRECT; aggregate×person DOWN-WEIGHTED;
# aggregate×universal ADJACENT; code×universal DIRECT; code×population NON-ANCHORING; code×person NON-ANCHORING;
# specific×person DIRECT; specific×population DIRECT (DOWN-WEIGHTED if generalizes_beyond_measured); specific×universal ADJACENT.
```

**Falsification conditions (doctrinal):** this architecture is wrong if — a rendering pipeline honoring I1–I5 cannot serve a named audience's canonical use-pattern without breaching an invariant (audience needs and integrity actually conflict); or a real cell arises whose correct handling requires re-ranking the ladder per mode rather than conditioning it (D-D's core is false); or representation-checking by disabled readers returns systematic "this is wrong about my experience" verdicts on determinations the machinery marks sound (the machinery measures the wrong thing). Any of these routes to a DR, not a silent patch.

88	4. **The person is the ground truth; the specification serves them.** A specification
89	   is an approximation in service of an individual — a starting hypothesis for a
90	   conversation, never a verdict about them (mission #7). Person Mode is not the
91	   exception the model escalates to; it is the reality the model approximates
92	   (mission #4: the population range "neither bounds nor defines the person"). Every
93	   default is overridable at the individual value (armature §4.3).
94	
95	5. **The irreducible remainder has a home.** What no coordinate captures — why two
96	   people at identical axis values live different lives — is curated in the
97	   `situations` entity (§5.4) and in Co-1 testimony, which are never subordinated to
98	   axis-level evidence (§3.1). Their existence in the schema is the project's
99	   structural admission that the person exceeds the profile.
100	
101	**Consequence for the enterprise (stated honestly).** Pushed to its end, this
102	principle is in tension with the whole idea of a specification guide. The project's
103	answer is that a generalization held *as* a generalization, with the individual as
104	the override and the ground truth, raises the floor where no individual assessment is
105	available — which is most of the built world, most of the time. The taxonomy is
106	legitimate only as an approximation in service of the individual, never as a portrait
107	of them. Where it is read as a portrait, it is being misused.
108	
109	**Owner adjudication (2026-07-21).** The enterprise-legitimacy question this principle
110	raises is settled in favour of proceeding: *something is better than nothing, and a
111	solution that serves 95% beats one that serves 50%.* The generalization is legitimate
112	**as the floor**; the individual override (Person Mode, situations, Co-1) carries the
113	remainder, so shipping the floor is not conceding the tail. This closes the ratified
114	posture — the taxonomy generalizes openly and declares that it does; it does not wait
115	for a per-person completeness it can never reach.
